errors.what: First clan read failed (doc.clan not found): the supplied paths are repo-root-relative but the agent cwd was the heavy/ subdirectory, so the path double-nested
errors.recovered_by: running every clan and cp command after cd-ing to the repo root so the repo-root-relative paths resolved

problems_and_friction: cwd was the heavy/ subdir rather than the repo root the task paths assume, needing an explicit cd to repo root each command. The working doc already held all 12 hops' data including my pricing_* fields, so this hop executed as an idempotent merge-patch over identical values.
context_understood: As pricing analyst I merge-patched bounded pricing_* findings (Zoho cheapest at EUR18,240/yr for 40 seats vs HubSpot 24,000; Salesforce out on cost) into the shared CRM doc without re-transcribing prior analysts, then validated and snapshotted, handing off to the risk analyst.
